# Johnson Controls announces fourth quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call Webcast

-
-

**CORK, Ireland**


**, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/** --[Johnson Controls International plc](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787190-1&h=3223836833&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.johnsoncontrols.com%2F&a=Johnson+Controls+International+plc) (NYSE: JCI), a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency and decarbonization, announces the following webcast:


What: Johnson Controls Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Conference Call


When: Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET


How: The earnings conference call for investors can be accessed:


- Live via webcast at[https://johnson-controls-q4-2026-earnings.open-exchange.net](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787190-1&h=2100578731&u=https%3A%2F%2Fjohnson-controls-q4-2026-earnings.open-exchange.net%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fjohnson-controls-q4-2026-earnings.open-exchange.net)


Note: A slide presentation will be available that morning for downloading.


- Replay: If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the call will be archived at[http://investors.johnsoncontrols.com/news-and-events/events-and-presentations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787190-1&h=1027083599&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.johnsoncontrols.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.johnsoncontrols.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents-and-presentations)


**About Johnson Controls**


Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.


For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.


Visit[johnsoncontrols.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787190-1&h=3629450659&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4614281-1%26h%3D3320188965%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.johnsoncontrols.com%252F%26a%3Djohnsoncontrols.com&a=johnsoncontrols.com) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.
